ex07.title: Crypto gas fees explained: stop overpaying
ex07.reel_caption:
Crypto gas fees explained: stop overpaying. ⛽

The same transfer can cost cents or many dollars because block space is limited and people bid to get in. 3 ways to pay less: check the fee before you confirm, wait for a quieter time, use a layer 2 like Arbitrum, Base or Optimism.
